options.title: General medical practice
options.description: Place or practice where people access primary medical care, first medical advice, prescriptions, routine checks, and general health support.

options.title: Medical clinic
options.description: Place where people can access outpatient medical services, consultations, diagnostic visits, or treatments without staying overnight.

options.title: Specialist medical service
options.description: Place or service where people access specialist medical care related to a specific health need or body system.

options.title: Hospital
options.description: Large healthcare facility where people access emergency care, specialised treatment, surgery, or inpatient services.

options.title: Dental practice
options.description: Place or practice where people receive care for teeth, mouth, and oral health, including visits, cleaning, treatments, and dental emergencies.

options.title: Pharmacy
options.description: Place where people obtain medicines, health-related products, and basic pharmaceutical advice.

options.title: Veterinary service
options.description: Place or service where pets and other animals receive medical care, check-ups, vaccinations, and treatment.

options.title: Childcare / daycare
options.description: Place where young children are looked after during the day, usually before school age or outside school hours.

options.title: School
options.description: Place where children or teenagers attend formal education in compulsory or upper secondary school.

options.title: University / college
options.description: Place where people attend higher education, tertiary study, or degree programmes.

options.title: Training centre
options.description: Place where people attend vocational, technical, or professional training outside standard school or university education.

options.title: Library
options.description: Place where people can read, borrow books, study, use learning resources, or spend time in a quiet educational environment.

options.title: Supermarket
options.description: Large shop where people buy groceries, household essentials, and other everyday products in one place.

options.title: Grocery store
options.description: Small or medium local shop where people buy everyday food and basic household items.

options.title: Bakery
options.description: Shop mainly selling bread, baked goods, and often simple everyday food items.

options.title: Market stall
options.description: Individual stall or small vendor stand located within a market area, where people buy specific goods such as food, produce, or other everyday items.

options.title: Restaurant
options.description: Place where people go to eat prepared meals, usually sitting down for lunch or dinner.

options.title: Café / bar
options.description: Place where people go for coffee, drinks, snacks, breakfast, or informal social time.

options.title: Employment location (analytical)
options.description: Work or employment location used for analytical job-access measures. It is not automatically a publicly accessible destination.

options.title: Coworking space
options.description: Shared place where freelancers, remote workers, or small teams work using common desks and services.

options.title: Bank
options.description: Place where people access financial services such as accounts, payments, advice, or cash withdrawal.

options.title: Post office
options.description: Place where people send or receive letters and parcels, and often access simple administrative or payment services.

options.title: Municipality office
options.description: Public office where people go for local administrative services, documents, registrations, permits, or civic support.

options.title: Community centre
options.description: Place where people meet for local activities, associations, events, support initiatives, or neighbourhood life.

options.title: Youth centre
options.description: Place offering activities, services, support, or meeting spaces mainly for children, teenagers, or young people.

options.title: Senior centre
options.description: Place offering activities, services, support, or social spaces mainly for older adults.

options.title: Cultural centre
options.description: Place where people take part in exhibitions, workshops, local events, arts activities, or other cultural experiences.

options.title: Cinema
options.description: Place where people watch films and access indoor entertainment.

options.title: Theatre
options.description: Place where people attend live performances such as plays, dance, music, or other stage events.

options.title: Museum
options.description: Place where people visit exhibitions, collections, heritage displays, or educational cultural experiences.

options.title: Park
options.description: Public outdoor green area where people can walk, rest, meet others, or spend time in open air.

options.title: Playground
options.description: Outdoor space designed for children to play, usually with swings, slides, or other play equipment.

options.title: Sports facility
options.description: Place where people exercise, train, play sport, or take part in physical activity indoors or outdoors.

options.title: Hairdresser / beauty
options.description: Place where people access routine grooming, hair, or personal care services.

options.title: Everyday repair service
options.description: Place or provider offering repair, adjustment or maintenance of everyday items.

options.title: Place of worship
options.description: Place where people gather for religious practice, ceremonies, reflection, or faith-based community life.

options.title: Telecom / digital access shop
options.description: Place providing phone, internet, SIM, device or other basic digital access services.

options.title: Print / copy shop
options.description: Place where people print, photocopy, scan documents, or use small practical administrative support services.

options.title: Laundromat
options.description: Place where people wash and dry clothes using self-service machines or laundry services supporting everyday domestic life.

options.title: Hardware / household store
options.description: Shop where people buy tools, materials, and household items for home maintenance, small repairs, and everyday domestic needs.

options.title: Home support service
options.description: Provider offering domestic assistance, cleaning, home help or independent-living support.

options.title: Diagnostic centre
options.description: Place providing laboratory tests, medical imaging or other diagnostic services.

options.title: Market / food market
options.description: Market place containing multiple vendors or stalls providing food and everyday goods.

options.title: Scheduled public transport service
options.description: A named line or scheduled transport service. Mode is stored separately, such as bus, tram, metro, rail or ferry.

options.title: Taxi / ride service
options.description: Taxi or ride service available within a defined area, with pickup points or flexible pickup.

options.title: Demand-responsive / community transport service
options.description: On-demand or community transport service operating through service areas, bookings or virtual stops.

options.title: Shared mobility service
options.description: Shared bicycle, scooter, car or cargo-bike service. Vehicle mode is stored separately.

options.title: Vehicle rental service
options.description: Service providing temporary rental of bicycles, cars or other vehicles.

options.title: Public parking facility
options.description: Publicly usable facility for parking motor vehicles.

options.title: Park-and-ride facility
options.description: Parking facility designed to support transfer to public transport or another mobility service.

options.title: Public transport station / terminal
options.description: Physical facility containing one or more public transport access points, platforms and mobility services.

options.title: Mobility hub / interchange
options.description: Multimodal facility where users can access or transfer between several mobility services and modes.

options.title: Bicycle parking facility
options.description: Standalone, secure or staffed facility for parking bicycles.

options.title: Public square / civic open space
options.description: Publicly accessible square, plaza, largo, piazzale or civic open space used for meeting, resting, events and everyday outdoor activity.

options.title: Delegated civic service point
options.description: Public-facing delegated point, operated outside municipal offices, where residents can access selected civic or administrative services.

options.title: Police / public safety station
options.description: Station or office where people can request police, law-enforcement or public-safety assistance.

options.title: Fire and rescue station
options.description: Station or facility providing fire prevention, emergency rescue and response services.

options.title: Family support centre
options.description: Place providing information, counselling, activities or practical support for families, parents and caregivers.

options.title: Shopping centre
options.description: Large retail complex containing multiple shops and often food, leisure or practical services.

options.title: Heritage / civic place
options.description: Publicly accessible site of historical, civic or local heritage interest.

it.#Place where people access financial ser: Luogo dove gestire conto, pagamenti, consulenza finanziaria o prelevare contanti.
it.#Place where people send or receive lett: Luogo dove spedire o ricevere lettere e pacchi e spesso svolgere semplici pratiche o pagamenti.
it.#Public office where people go for local: Ufficio pubblico per documenti, registrazioni, permessi e altri servizi amministrativi locali.
it.#Place where people meet for local activ: Luogo dove incontrarsi per attività locali, associazioni, eventi, iniziative di supporto e vita di quartiere.

it.#Place where people watch films and acce: Luogo dove vedere film e partecipare ad attività di intrattenimento al chiuso.
it.#Place where people attend live performa: Luogo dove assistere a spettacoli dal vivo come teatro, danza, musica o altre esibizioni sul palco.
it.#Place where people visit exhibitions, c: Luogo dove visitare mostre, collezioni e contenuti legati a cultura, storia o patrimonio.

it.#Outdoor space designed for children to: Spazio all'aperto pensato per il gioco dei bambini, spesso con altalene, scivoli o altre attrezzature.
it.#Place where people exercise, train, pla: Luogo al chiuso o all'aperto dove fare esercizio, allenarsi o praticare sport.
it.#Place where people access routine groom: Luogo per servizi abituali di capelli, barba, estetica e cura personale.
it.#Place or provider offering repair, adju: Luogo o servizio per riparare, adattare o mantenere oggetti di uso quotidiano.
it.#Place where people gather for religious: Luogo dove riunirsi per preghiera, cerimonie, riflessione o attività della comunità religiosa.
it.#Place providing phone, internet, SIM, d: Luogo che offre servizi per telefono, internet, SIM, dispositivi e altre esigenze digitali di base.

it.#Place where people wash and dry clothes: Luogo dove lavare e asciugare i vestiti con macchine self-service o con un servizio di lavanderia.
it.#Shop where people buy tools, materials,: Negozio dove acquistare attrezzi, materiali e prodotti per piccole riparazioni, manutenzione e bisogni domestici.

it.#household goods store: negozio di articoli per la casa

it.#Market place containing multiple vendor: Area di mercato con più venditori o banchi che offrono alimenti e prodotti di uso quotidiano.
it.#Scheduled public transport service: Servizio di trasporto pubblico di linea

it.#Taxi or ride service available within a: Servizio taxi o con conducente disponibile in una determinata area, con punti di prelievo fissi o flessibili.
it.#On-demand or community transport servic: Servizio di trasporto su richiesta o di comunità che funziona tramite prenotazione, aree di servizio o fermate virtuali.
it.#Shared bicycle, scooter, car or cargo-b: Servizio di biciclette, monopattini, auto o cargo bike condivisi. Il tipo di veicolo è indicato separatamente.
it.#Service providing temporary rental of b: Servizio per noleggiare temporaneamente biciclette, auto o altri veicoli.
it.#Publicly usable facility for parking mo: Struttura aperta al pubblico dove parcheggiare veicoli a motore.
it.#Parking facility designed to support tr: Parcheggio pensato per lasciare un veicolo e proseguire il viaggio con il trasporto pubblico o un altro servizio di mobilità.

it.#Multimodal facility where users can acc: Struttura multimodale dove usare o cambiare tra più servizi e mezzi di trasporto.
it.#Standalone, secure or staffed facility: Struttura indipendente, sicura o sorvegliata per parcheggiare biciclette.
it.#Publicly accessible square, plaza, larg: Piazza o altro spazio pubblico aperto, accessibile a tutti, usato per incontrarsi, riposare, partecipare a eventi e svolgere attività quotidiane all'aperto.

it.#Station or office where people can requ: Stazione o ufficio dove chiedere assistenza alla polizia o ad altri servizi di sicurezza pubblica.
it.#Fire and rescue station: Caserma dei vigili del fuoco e soccorso
it.#Station or facility providing fire prev: Stazione o struttura per prevenzione incendi, interventi dei vigili del fuoco e soccorso in emergenza.
it.#Place providing information, counsellin: Luogo che offre informazioni, consulenza, attività o aiuto pratico a famiglie, genitori e caregiver.
it.#Large retail complex containing multipl: Grande complesso con più negozi e spesso anche ristorazione, svago o servizi pratici.
it.#Publicly accessible site of historical,: Luogo aperto al pubblico di interesse storico, civico o legato alla memoria locale.

fr.#Place or practice where people access p: Cabinet où recevoir des soins médicaux de base, un premier avis, des ordonnances et des contrôles courants.
fr.#Place where people can access outpatien: Établissement où recevoir des consultations, examens ou traitements sans hospitalisation.
fr.#Place or service where people access sp: Lieu ou service où recevoir des soins spécialisés pour un besoin de santé précis.
fr.#Large healthcare facility where people: Grand établissement de santé proposant urgences, soins spécialisés, interventions et hospitalisation.
fr.#Place or practice where people receive: Lieu où recevoir des examens, nettoyages, soins et urgences pour les dents et la santé bucco-dentaire.
fr.#Place where people obtain medicines, he: Lieu où acheter des médicaments et des produits de santé et recevoir des conseils pharmaceutiques de base.
fr.#Place or service where pets and other a: Lieu ou service où les animaux reçoivent des consultations, vaccins et traitements.
fr.#Place where young children are looked a: Lieu où les jeunes enfants sont gardés pendant la journée, avant l'école ou en dehors des heures scolaires.
fr.#Place where children or teenagers atten: Lieu où les enfants et adolescents suivent l'enseignement scolaire obligatoire ou secondaire.
fr.#Place where people attend higher educat: Lieu d'enseignement supérieur, d'études universitaires et de formations diplômantes.
fr.#Place where people attend vocational, t: Lieu proposant des formations professionnelles, techniques ou pour adultes en dehors du parcours scolaire ou universitaire classique.
fr.#Place where people can read, borrow boo: Lieu où lire, emprunter des livres, étudier et utiliser des ressources d'apprentissage.
fr.#Large shop where people buy groceries,: Grand magasin où acheter de la nourriture, des produits ménagers et d'autres biens du quotidien.
fr.#Small or medium local shop where people: Petit ou moyen magasin de proximité où acheter de la nourriture et des produits ménagers de base.
fr.#Shop mainly selling bread, baked goods,: Magasin vendant surtout du pain, des produits de boulangerie et souvent des aliments simples du quotidien.
fr.#Individual stall or small vendor stand: Stand ou petit point de vente dans un marché, où acheter des produits précis comme fruits, légumes, poisson, vêtements ou articles ménagers.
fr.#Place where people go to eat prepared m: Lieu où manger des repas préparés, généralement assis pour le déjeuner ou le dîner.
fr.#Place where people go for coffee, drink: Lieu où prendre un café, une boisson, une collation ou un petit-déjeuner et se rencontrer de façon informelle.
fr.#Work or employment location used for an: Lieu utilisé pour mesurer l'accès à l'emploi. Il n'est pas nécessairement ouvert au public.
fr.#Shared place where freelancers, remote: Espace de travail partagé pour indépendants, télétravailleurs ou petites équipes, avec postes et services communs.
fr.#Place where people access financial ser: Lieu où gérer un compte, effectuer des paiements, obtenir des conseils financiers ou retirer de l'argent.
fr.#Place where people send or receive lett: Lieu où envoyer ou recevoir lettres et colis et souvent effectuer de petites démarches ou paiements.
fr.#Public office where people go for local: Bureau public pour documents, inscriptions, autorisations et autres services administratifs locaux.
fr.#Place where people meet for local activ: Lieu de rencontre pour activités locales, associations, événements, initiatives d'entraide et vie de quartier.
fr.#Place offering activities, services, su: Lieu proposant activités, services, soutien et espaces de rencontre surtout pour adolescents et jeunes.
Lieu proposant activités, services, soutien et espaces sociaux principalement pour les personnes âgées.
fr.#Place where people take part in exhibit: Lieu pour expositions, ateliers, événements locaux, activités artistiques et autres expériences culturelles.
fr.#Place where people watch films and acce: Lieu où voir des films et profiter d'activités de divertissement en intérieur.
fr.#Place where people attend live performa: Lieu où assister à des spectacles vivants comme théâtre, danse, musique ou autres représentations sur scène.
fr.#Place where people visit exhibitions, c: Lieu où visiter des expositions, collections et contenus liés à la culture, à l'histoire ou au patrimoine.
fr.#Public outdoor green area where people: Espace vert public en plein air où marcher, se reposer, rencontrer d'autres personnes ou passer du temps dehors.
fr.#Outdoor space designed for children to: Espace extérieur conçu pour le jeu des enfants, souvent avec balançoires, toboggans ou autres équipements.
fr.#Place where people exercise, train, pla: Lieu intérieur ou extérieur où faire de l'exercice, s'entraîner ou pratiquer un sport.
fr.#Place where people access routine groom: Lieu pour les soins courants des cheveux, de la barbe, de beauté et de la personne.
